goalsTotalsAll: Totals cover every goal. Revenue is summed per currency; deal and activity goals are not in the money totals.
goalsTotalsActive: {active, plural, =1{Totals cover the 1 active goal of {count}. Revenue is summed per currency.} other{Totals cover the {active} active goals of {count}. Revenue is summed per currency.}}
goalsLeaderboardEmpty: Nothing to rank yet. The board covers monthly goals running today, and shows the ones you can see: your own, and your teams'.
goalsLeaderboardNote: Ranked on attainment against each person's own target, not on raw revenue. Otherwise the biggest patch wins every quarter regardless of who worked hardest.
goalsEmptyAdmin: A goal is a target and a period. Progress is counted from the deals closed inside it, so nothing needs updating by hand.
goalsEmptyMember: Nothing is assigned to you or your teams. An administrator sets these.
goalsNoMatchBody: Nothing here matches the search and period you picked. Clearing the filter shows everything you can see.
goalsHistoryFootnote: The twelve most recent periods you can see. Attainment is recomputed from the closed-won deals of each period, so it matches what the goals screen showed while the period was running.
goalsHistoryMet: {attained} of {count, plural, =1{{count} goal} other{{count} goals}} met
goalsHistoryEmptyBody: Once a goal's period ends it moves here with what it attained. Goals still running are on the goals screen.
goalsFormDeleteBody: The goal and its record of the period go for good. Nothing that was closed against it changes: those deals stay exactly as they are. To stop tracking a goal without losing it, retire it instead.
goalsFormCurrencyHelper: Only won deals in this currency count
goalsFormTargetDeals: How many deals must close in the period
goalsFormTargetActivities: How many activities must be logged in the period
goalsFormTargetRevenue: Total revenue that must close in the period
goalsFormWeightHint: A multiplier on each closed-won deal of that type. Leave a box empty to count that type in full. At 0.5 a 20,000 renewal counts as 10,000; at 0 it does not count at all.
goalsFormPeriodHint: The period type groups goals on the leaderboard. The dates below are what progress is counted against.
goalsFormActiveHint: A retired goal stays on the list and stops counting towards the totals and the leaderboard.
goalsFormAdminsOnly: Only an administrator can add or change a goal. You can see the ones set for you and your teams on the goals list.
